authority_note: Additive research checkpoint only. companies/MPWR/latest.json, registry/companies.json, reviews/latest.json, canonical raw-data, baseline-lock and frozen deterministic outputs remain unchanged; current canonical authority remains the 2026-09-06 preliminary review until a separate reviewed promotion.
portfolio_context: Actual holding, tax basis and portfolio risk budget were not supplied in this run. No position size is invented and buy authorization remains false.
structural_thesis: Monolithic Power Systems is expanding from point power-management components toward higher-value full power solutions across AI data centers, automotive, communications and industrial markets. Q2 2026 Enterprise Data revenue accelerated sharply and MPS is sampling high-voltage AC-to-DC products for emerging 800V data-center architectures, but the durability of design wins and economics of capacity expansion must be separated from current demand acceleration.
current_finding: Harness-rule TTM diagnostics are approximately $3.273B revenue, $0.940B operating income, $0.802B net income and $0.822B operating cash flow. TTM disclosed PPE purchases were about $0.237B, leaving mechanical OCF-minus-PPE of about $0.586B. Subtracting TTM stock-based compensation of about $0.209B gives a conservative $0.377B diagnostic, but neither measure is normalized owner FCF because working capital, intangibles, supply-capacity economics and other reinvestment are not fully normalized.
economic_finding: Q2 2026 revenue was $980.6M, up 47.6% year over year, with Enterprise Data revenue $380.6M, up 164.3%, and GAAP operating margin 31.0%. Q3 revenue guidance midpoint is approximately $1.15B. MPS is sampling 800V-oriented high-voltage AC-to-DC solutions and expanding manufacturing through a long-term GlobalFoundries 300mm partnership, but 800V commercialization and post-ramp economics are not yet realized evidence.
capital_and_survival: June 2026 cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments totaled about $1.414B. No balance-sheet debt line was identified in the reviewed Q2 10-Q. Financial survivability is therefore strong, but capital-allocation quality is constrained by an unresolved material weakness in deferred-tax accounting, 2024 restatement history, meaningful SBC, rising share count and large planned capacity expansion.
permanent_loss_case: AI core-power design share shifts to competitors or 800V architectures favor broader grid-to-core vendors; new manufacturing capacity ramps below utilization targets; Enterprise Data growth normalizes; inventory and receivables absorb cash; SBC continues to expand share count; the deferred-tax control weakness is not remediated or another material restatement occurs; margins normalize; and a valuation priced for long-duration near-bull execution compresses even though the company remains solvent.
falsifiers: The deferred-tax material weakness remains unresolved through FY2026 or another material financial-statement restatement occurs.
Enterprise Data growth and design wins weaken for multiple quarters while manufacturing capacity continues to expand.
800V-related sampling fails to convert to production wins across multiple customers or a competing architecture materially reduces MPS wallet share.
Operating cash flow per share after PPE investment and SBC structurally lags revenue and earnings growth for multiple periods.
Inventory and receivables rise persistently while distributor sell-through or end-demand weakens.
New-capacity after-tax incremental returns fail to exceed the 9% hurdle after ramp.
Annual share-count growth remains around or above 2% without offsetting per-share owner-cash growth.
Operating margin falls toward the low-20s while revenue growth simultaneously normalizes.
A previously undisclosed fatal dependence on one AI accelerator, end customer or platform becomes evident.
Market expectations remain near bull-case economics while business evidence deteriorates.
increase_evidence: The deferred-tax material weakness is fully remediated, controls are assessed effective and no repeat material misstatement emerges.
800V samples convert into production wins across multiple data-center customers rather than one concentrated accelerator program.
Enterprise Data and non-data-center segments grow while distributor and underlying customer concentration do not worsen materially.
OCF per share after PPE investment and SBC improves for at least two reporting periods while inventory and receivables normalize.
GlobalFoundries and other capacity cohorts produce after-tax incremental returns above the 9% hurdle after ramp.
Repurchases are executed with price discipline and begin to offset employee-equity issuance and share-count growth.
Expectation gap becomes clearly favorable through a materially lower price or materially higher normalized owner cash; price decline alone is insufficient.
sell_evidence: Repeated material weaknesses, another material restatement or evidence of management/accounting integrity impairment.
Sustained AI design-share loss while capacity commitments continue to rise.
800V commercialization misses key customer ramps and competitors lock in materially stronger grid-to-core positions.
OCF per share after capex and SBC persistently declines despite accounting revenue growth.
Inventory and receivables deteriorate while channel demand weakens.
Dilution remains structurally high without matching owner-cash-per-share growth.
Realized incremental returns on new manufacturing capacity fall below the 9% hurdle.
Valuation remains near bull-case economics while product, margin or cash evidence weakens.

evidence: Q2 2026 Enterprise Data revenue grew 164.3% YoY and MPS is extending its power portfolio toward high-voltage AC-to-DC solutions for 800V data-center architectures.
The company is investing for capacity significantly beyond $6B of annual revenue and formed a long-term 300mm manufacturing partnership with GlobalFoundries.
counter_evidence: 800V products were still sampling at Q2 and architecture leadership can shift quickly among large AI-platform suppliers.

evidence: MPS competes on efficiency, integration, size and system-level power solutions across AI, automotive and industrial applications.
Q2 operating margin expanded while revenue accelerated, consistent with strong customer value rather than subsidy-driven growth.
counter_evidence: Semiconductor design wins are architecture-specific and customers can dual-source or redesign at platform transitions.
missing_data: Independent customer-level retention and wallet-share data.

evidence: Proprietary process, packaging and system design combined with broader full-solution offerings support a widening technical and integration moat.
The GlobalFoundries partnership diversifies manufacturing and can support next-generation AI/cloud power stages.
counter_evidence: Infineon and other large analog/power vendors are expanding broad grid-to-core and 800V portfolios, so MPS is not an uncontested platform leader.
missing_data: Independent long-duration design-share data across AI accelerators and 800V platforms.

evidence: TTM operating margin is about 28.7% and revenue growth accelerated materially.
The balance sheet can fund capacity expansion internally.
counter_evidence: H1 2026 OCF declined year over year despite much higher net income, PPE spending rose, and inventory/working-capital needs remain material.
Mechanical OCF-PPE-SBC is only about $0.377B TTM, far below accounting earnings.
missing_data: Post-ramp after-tax incremental returns on GlobalFoundries and other capacity cohorts.

evidence: Founder-led product execution and a $1B total repurchase authorization provide potential capital-allocation flexibility.
The company continues to invest in R&D, capacity and supply-chain diversification.
counter_evidence: A material deferred-tax accounting weakness remains unremediated after a material 2024 restatement; the CFO role is interim following retirement; H1 repurchases were minimal while share count continued to rise.
missing_data: Effective remediation evidence and sustained buyback-versus-SBC discipline.

evidence: June cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments totaled about $1.414B and operating cash flow remains strongly positive.
No balance-sheet debt line was identified in the reviewed Q2 10-Q.
counter_evidence: Working-capital and capacity requirements can consume cash during a sharp demand normalization.

evidence: At $1,186.08, the new Base value of about $680 is roughly 43% below price.
Holding Base economics requires roughly 19.35% annual revenue growth in years 2-10 at a 9% required return, implying year-10 revenue above $21B.
counter_evidence: Current Q2 revenue growth, Enterprise Data acceleration and management's capacity plans show that a high-growth path is not demonstrably impossible.
missing_data: Normalized owner-cash margin through an AI cycle and realized 800V design-share economics.

evidence: A successful Bull case still supports value around $1,569 per share and much larger long-term earnings power.
counter_evidence: Bull upside is only about 32% from the reference price while Bear downside is about 82%; the starting valuation absorbs much of the operating upside.

evidence: FY2024 was materially restated for deferred-income-tax accounting by about $194.6M, and the related material weakness remained unremediated as of June 30, 2026.
EY issued an unqualified financial-statement opinion, and no evidence reviewed establishes intentional misconduct; current securities litigation remains allegation, not proof.
items.resolution_needed: Demonstrate effective remediation, sustained control operation and no repeat material misstatement.

evidence: Approximately $1.414B of cash and short-term investments plus positive operating cash flow support operations and current reinvestment without structural external financing dependence.
items.resolution_needed: Monitor if capacity commitments materially outrun internally generated cash.

evidence: Share count rose meaningfully and SBC is material, but current evidence does not yet establish long-duration excessive dilution under the veto definition.
items.resolution_needed: Require disciplined repurchases or per-share cash growth if annual share-count expansion approaches or exceeds roughly 2% for a sustained period.

evidence: Revenue growth is accompanied by high operating margins and shipment-based demand across Enterprise Data, communications, automotive and other end markets; no customer-subsidy or financing mechanism was identified.
items.resolution_needed: Monitor channel inventory, end-customer demand and receivable quality.

evidence: No collapse is proven, but capacity expansion beyond $6B, rising PPE investment and working-capital absorption require cohort-level return validation.
items.resolution_needed: Measure post-ramp utilization, incremental NOPAT, working capital and cash returns versus the 9% hurdle.

evidence: Enterprise Data growth, new-product sampling and manufacturing diversification do not show persistent moat contraction.
items.resolution_needed: Track AI platform design share, 800V production wins and competitive pricing.

evidence: The reference price requires about 19.35% annual revenue growth for nine years after a $4.4B year-1 Base revenue assumption, with a 20% mature owner margin and 25x terminal multiple.
This is highly demanding but not demonstrably impossible given current AI/data-center growth, so the gate remains open rather than an outright reject trigger.
items.resolution_needed: Require materially stronger normalized owner-cash evidence or a much larger valuation discount before buy authorization.

evidence: Distribution concentration is high, but MPS states distributors can be replaced in relatively short order and revenue spans Enterprise Data, computing, automotive, communications, consumer and industrial end markets.
items.resolution_needed: Obtain greater transparency on underlying AI end-customer concentration and monitor distributor/AR concentration.

evidence: Bankruptcy risk is low, but design-win risk, accounting-control risk, capacity expansion and a valuation near bull-like economics can create multi-year permanent capital impairment.
items.resolution_needed: Resolve control weakness, validate capacity returns and establish a materially better expectation gap.

attacks: A major AI accelerator or hyperscaler shifts core-power design share to a competitor or dual-sources aggressively.
The transition to 800V architectures favors broader SiC/GaN grid-to-core vendors and reduces MPS wallet share.
Enterprise Data growth normalizes much faster than current expectations after the AI infrastructure buildout.
Capacity planned beyond $6B and the GlobalFoundries ramp create underutilized manufacturing economics.
Inventory, receivables and channel working capital absorb cash even while GAAP earnings grow.
Distributor and accounts-receivable concentration amplify channel volatility or obscure underlying end-customer concentration.
SBC and share issuance offset a meaningful portion of absolute FCF growth.
The deferred-tax material weakness is not remediated or another financial-statement restatement occurs.
Tariffs, export controls or China-related supply/demand restrictions impair manufacturing or end demand.
A 70x-plus earnings and roughly 100x mechanical cash valuation compresses even if the business continues to grow.

explicit_model_uncertainties: Post-ramp incremental ROIC on new capacity
Normalized owner cash after SBC and working capital
